page.notes: Left column, first line: the printed word appears to be "foluitur"; the long s is read as s, so it is given as "soluitur". "Trebelliano ... 2.87": the last digits are hard to read and are marked [?]. The entry "Seruitutibus rusticorum & urbanorum" runs over the column break ("vr" / "banorum"). The printed hyphen in "fideicom-missum" is kept. Page numbers and references are as printed; no number is printed on the page.
